name: unhappypath
description: Reproducible failure experiments for mobile user journeys. Local fixtures, independent assertions, readable evidence.
author: Dharmendra Sharma

scripts.lint: prettier --check src test scripts examples/adapter.mjs package.json tsconfig.json .github
scripts.format: prettier --write src test scripts examples/adapter.mjs package.json tsconfig.json .github
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js demo
scripts.ios:demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js demo --driver ios
scripts.test:report: npm run build && playwright test test/report.spec.mjs --workers=1
